text:
Rina P (People Ops): Quick ping 1 — drafting a tiny set of "goal + evidence" one-liners managers can paste into reviews. Want them ultra-short for async reviews.

Rina P: Core idea: each card = 3 lines: Goal (measurable), Evidence (links/ids), One-line ask (what help they need).

Omar T (Eng): Love the brevity. Can we add a single 'who benefited' line so cross-team impact is explicit?

Rina P: Good call 1 adding 'Beneficiary' as an optional fourth line.

Kelly M (Manager): Also recommend a short calibration question managers can add: "How would you rate risk vs reward (Low/Med/High)?" Helps with stack ranking conversations.

Rina P: Draft examples:
```
IC (Senior)
Goal: Reduce P95 inference latency by 12% for chat-api
Evidence: PR#2151, perf-eval-2026-02
Ask: Need help prioritizing rollout nights
Beneficiary: Search team

Manager
Goal: Onboard shared-batching to 2 teams
Evidence: onboarding-tickets, runbook-v1
Ask: Support from infra on canary plan
Beneficiary: Product X
```

Omar T: Tiny nit 1 can 'Evidence' accept qualitative items like customer quotes?

Rina P: Yes, we'll allow "qualitative" tag if no metric.

hr-bot: Draft posted: https://handbook.redwood.company/people-ops/short-goal-cards

Kelly M: I'll try these in my next round of reviews and share feedback.

Rina P: Thanks! Plan to finalize and add to the form header tomorrow.
